000_prologue_event.title: A Strange Start
000_prologue_event.narr_text: You wake in your camp with no memories to speak of. There is a military base camp nearby, maybe they can be of assitance?

001_base_entered.title: Entering the Base
001_base_entered.narr_text: Curious for some answers you tell the soldiers to take you to their general. The General briefs you on the mission at hand.

001_stay.title: Nah, not worth it.
001_stay.narr_text: You decide that this military base is not worth the trouble, so you decide to stay out of it and spend the rest of your days out of harm's way.

002_listen.title: A mission
002_listen.narr_text:
You listen to the General and instructs you locate a secret lab they suspect is hidden past the mountains.
		However, another soldier is tagging along with you to assist.

002_imprisoned.title: Jailed
002_imprisoned.narr_text: You refuse to listen to what they have to say. The soldiers imprison you.

003_proceed.title: A new companion
003_proceed.narr_text:
With your new all in tow, you proceed outside and walk for several hours.
		Until you reach another military base

2.text: Use the old sewer system beneath.

004_high_road.title: The high road
004_high_road.narr_text: Deciding that the high road is the best option you take a well hidden path leading into the mountain.

004_low_road.title: The low road
004_low_road.narr_text: Taking the low road, you sneak underneath the enemy base and sneak right under their noses.

005_cave_choice.title: Up or Below?
005_cave_choice.narr_text:
You and McConnell reach a dead end. But you can see some holds along the wall that seem sturdy.
		There is also a small hole near the bottom of the wall that is about your size.

006_sewer_choice.title: Exhausting
006_sewer_choice.narr_text:
You have walking though the sewers for some time now and both of you are tired.
		There are enemies nearby, but will you keep going or camp and rest for the night?

1.text: Camp and rest for the night.

2.text: No time to rest, keep going.

007_reach_lab.title: The goal in sight
007_reach_lab.narr_text:
You have finally reached the entrance to the lab, but no one is around save for a few dead guards.
		There is a control panel that will open the door loudly which may alert someone else, or swipe one of the guard's keycard and use a service entrance instead?

010_game_over.title: End of the road
010_game_over.narr_text: Your adventure is over. You were never able to complete your mission.

011_game_finish.title: To be continued...
011_game_finish.narr_text: You enter the lab, the first thing you and McConnell see, a massaacre. Every scientist dead. Who could have done this? To be continued...

1.text: Your adventure is complete for now To be continued...
